dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: The route for this patrol... Mm, looks good to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: Greetings, Honorary Knight! I am Nannina, previously second-in-command at the 3rd Company. I'm currently a General Staff member at the expeditionary force.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: I will also be assisting Master Varka with some administrative work after Cardinal Seamus returns to Mondstadt. Please let me know if there's anything I can help you with.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your work right now...

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: As you can see, Honorary Knight, the expeditionary force is currently engaged in combat operations against the Wild Hunt in various locations across Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: I'm responsible for coordinating company operations, dispatching support where needed, and maintaining patrol routes to ensure the logistical corridor remains secure.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: In theory, the logistics part should be handled by 8th Coy... but theory only gets you so far. Making sure that everyone gets home safely — I see that as part of my duty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your work right now...

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: Although we've more or less achieved the initial objectives of this expedition, we still have a lot of work to do.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: You're the Honorary Knight, after all, it goes without saying that no secrets should be kept from you. In addition to gathering intelligence, we are also actively surveying and scouting Amsvartnir.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: Based on the records we have on hand, there seems to be a strong connection among Amsvartnir, the Knight of Boreas, and Andrius the Wolf King...

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: However, for some unknown reason, the local inhabitants know very little about these matters. Grand Master Varka's orders are for us to conduct further investigation into the area.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the 3rd Company...

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: We... No, I should not be using "we" anymore. They are the backbone responsible for maintaining our frontlines, and the largest unit among the Knights of Favonius by headcount.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: The 3rd Coy's operations do not rely on the individual valor of any single knight, but rather on tactics, discipline, and coordination between the various arms.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: From light infantry to heavy cavalry, and including the newer units bearing muskets and alchemy devices, every knight functions as a unique gear in this war machine.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: So long as everyone upholds their duties, victory and freedom will prevail for Mondstadt. This is our... ahem, I mean the 3rd Company's creed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for your time.

dialogues.speaker: Nannina
dialogues.text: I'll see you, Honorary Knight. And if you need any help, you know where to find me.
